prompt: Create a high-energy Japanese festival anime illustration of cute hamsters performing taiko drums at night. Use a square 1:1 canvas, dynamic manga perspective, warm golden stage lighting, explosive radial speed lines from the top center, falling multicolored confetti, and a packed matsuri crowd in the background. In the foreground, show exactly 3 main hamster drummers: left hamster in a blue happi coat winking while holding one drumstick, center hamster largest in a red happi coat joyfully raising one drumstick and striking with the other, and right hamster in a dark navy happi coat smiling with eyes closed while holding two drumsticks. Place exactly 3 large wooden taiko drums across the bottom foreground, each with rope lacing, black studs, and a black tomoe-style crest on the drum body. Behind them, fill the scene with a dense crowd of smaller hamster drummers wearing headbands and happi coats, carrying sticks and cheering; include festival lanterns on both sides and two vertical festival banners labeled 「祭」. Add exactly 5 oversized red-and-black Japanese manga sound-effect clusters reading 「ド」 or 「ドン」 across the upper half, with thick white outlines and black drop shadows. In the top-right corner, add a white rectangular narration box with a black border containing vertical Japanese text: その宴は三日三晩続いた. Visual style: polished colorful anime, cute mascot character design, glossy eyes, rosy cheeks, expressive open mouths, detailed wooden drums, dramatic comic-book impact lines, saturated orange-yellow festival atmosphere, crisp line art, no photorealism, no watermark.
